title: Raster Zoom Composite Fix
description: Fix raster zoom bugs: composite/navigator camera mismatch, blue selection outline misaligned, content not scaling on zoom.
summary: Fixed raster composite/navigator zoom architecture: composite keeps session camera in React/WASM without document re-sync on zoom; navigator uses fit-to-bounds overview camera with React viewport overlay driven by composite camera + composite viewport; WASM selection chrome disabled in navigator view; framework host wires contentViewport/onViewportChange; pick/hover/pan paths restored for composite vs navigator; added core/play tests for navigator camera helpers and composite viewport command.
